# Contributing data

The main data object `derappp` is produced by the scripts under `data_generation`.
Some of these scripts like `00_substances.R` only read data from this directory
and from the internet. Others, like `10_aquatic_toxicity.R` check for updated
input files in the directory specified in the environment variable
`_derappp_input_`.

In the first case, for example if you would like to add chemical entities, you
can amend the input files like e.g. `data_generation/00_substances/chents.yml`
and study and run the corresponding script e.g. `00_substances.R`, watching
out for instructions in the comments. This will lead to updated data in 
`data_generation/cache/`. When done with the changes, you need to run
`data_generation/99_derappp.R` which will check for referential integrity
of the data (are unique keys really unique, do the target entries for foreign
keys exist) and write updated text representations of the data objects
to the `json` directory, so you can use `git diff` for reviewing
changes in these JSON files.

In the second case, you do not necessarily need to set up and specify
a `_derappp_input_` directory. You can also prepare excel sheets derived from
those that can be found e.g. under `data_generation/06_soil_sorption/` or
`data_generation/10_aquatic_toxicity/` and upload them to github by navigating
to the directory on github, and use the button `Add file` and then select
`Upload files`.

# Versioning

In order to support reproducible workflows, every commit that changes 
data objects should specify an incremented version component in the
DESCRIPTION file. For versions under development, we use numbers starting with
9000 as the fourth version component, e.g. version `0.9.4.9002` is the third
incremental change since version `0.9.4`, after `0.9.4.9000` and `0.9.4.9001`.
